static_traits.name: Li Tairan
static_traits.social_status: Keeping a low profile in interpersonal interactions out of fear of being judged, struggling to build intimate relationships; has a friend to talk about Average issues with, but unwilling to discuss the Anxiety of being judged with them
static_traits.medical_history: No obvious physical illness; no prior psychological problems or counseling/treatment history
static_traits.language_features: Expresses clearly, fairly cooperative; cautious tone, often uses hedging expressions like 'I guess / maybe / I am not sure'; capable of some self-Reflection

basic_info.main_problem: I worry people will label me as lazy and stupid because I smoke marijuana; this Fear causes me Anxiety and affects my self-image.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because the Anxiety about being judged by others for smoking marijuana is affecting my daily life and causing me distress.
growth_experiences: About a year ago, a colleague made a mocking negative comment about his marijuana habit; his stress level was high at the time, and he began excessively worrying about others' opinions of him. Afterwards, the Anxiety of feeling judged in social and Work settings gradually intensified, especially when others mentioned habits similar to his, the Anxiety and Self-doubt became more pronounced. He tried downplaying his use and avoiding related topics, but the Fear has not yet eased, and Sleep and diet rhythms disrupted has also appeared.

core_beliefs: I am lazy and stupid (once labeled, hard to shake off)
Others will see me through negative labels for a long time

special_situations.event: A year ago, a colleague made sarcastic/negative comments about his marijuana use habit
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If someone has a negative evaluation of my habits, it means most people will see me the same way
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Downplaying one's own use, keeping a low profile to avoid being noticed
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Everyone will think I am lazy and stupid.

special_situations.event: When getting along with others at work or in social settings
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If they know or associate me with smoking marijuana, they will definitely look down on me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids discussing related topics, tries to minimize one's presence
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They already treat me as a 'lazy addict' now.

special_situations.event: When others discuss habit topics similar to smoking marijuana
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others mention similar habits, it means they are hinting at me and judging me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Quickly changes the topic or goes silent to avoid being drawn in
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are saying I am not disciplined and stupid.

special_situations.event: When Performance affected at Work due to Anxiety
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my performance is affected, it proves those negative labels will always accompany me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Further avoids exposing own habits and reduces communication with people
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will be labeled 'lazy, stupid' for my whole life.

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be accepted by others, treated as a whole person rather than defined by a single habit
core_conflict.fear: Afraid of being humiliated and rejected, of being labeled 'lazy and stupid'
defense_goal: Keeps a low profile and avoids related topics to lower the risk of being judged
Negating the outside world's negative interpretations by downplaying use

object_relations.self_representation: A self easily judged, carrying shame
object_relations.object_representation: Picky others/colleagues with a derogatory tone

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking in counseling about 'how others view their marijuana-use habit' or being invited to conduct a reality test
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Worries that once exposed or tested, it will confirm that others really are judging her negatively
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Expresses worry in a cautious, tactful tone, proposes starting from smaller, safer steps (such as first communicating with a trusted friend), and requests support and review during the process.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: Topics related to smoking marijuana appear in social / work settings
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The other person is insinuating and judging oneself (attributing self-criticism to others)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Avoid eye contact, quickly Displacement the topic or stay Silence, ending the discussion with brief neutral statements.

manifestations: Avoids talking about related topics for fear of being judged, keeps a low profile
Hard to build intimate relationships; feels isolated in socializing
Feels a dilemma between personal choice (using marijuana) and external evaluation
Worrying about being permanently labeled for one's choices
outcomes: Limits self-expression and interaction to avoid being judged

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Reducing self-disclosure in counseling with cautious expressions like 'I guess / maybe / I am not sure'
Shows nervousness about the reality test to be conducted, tending to start from the smallest, safest attempt

exception_events.target_problem: In social or work situations, the client usually worries about being labeled 'lazy, stupid' and avoids talking about related topics.
exception_events.unique_outcome: When spending time with friends (who know his overall situation), the friends do not mind his marijuana habit and view him with acceptance; the client experiences being understood rather than being reduced to a label.
exception_events.reason: Different support: the friends have known him for a long time and formed an accepting attitude based on a more complete understanding; different situation: the trusting relationship lowers the threat of judgment.

positive_force: Has a friend who holds an accepting attitude toward them, able to provide emotional support and reality evidence
Willing to try small-step reality testing and behavioral experiments
Able to notice that 'feeling real does not equal fact', with some self-Reflection ability
Retains a certain sense of hope, willing to work with the counselor
negative_force: Negative cognitive patterns such as catastrophizing, mind reading, and overgeneralization reinforced the sense of being judged
Avoiding discussion and lowering self-disclosure keep Anxiety maintained and expanding
Marked Self-doubt, readily accepting negative labels as self-definition
Sleep and eating rhythms disturbed, further weakening emotion and cognitive regulation abilities

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids discussing marijuana-related topics, keeping a low profile socially and at work
antecedent: Interacting in social or work environments
When others mention habits similar to smoking marijuana
target_behavior.core_reason: Fear of being labeled 'lazy, stupid' by others and being Being rejected/humiliated (catastrophizing and mind-reading about others' evaluations)
target_behavior.function: Avoids possible negative evaluation and shame
target_behavior.consequence: Ongoing Anxiety, difficulty building intimate relationships, Work performance affected

target_behavior.behavior: Reducing interaction in social and Work settings, Withdrawal
antecedent: In work or social settings, feeling noticed or judged by others
When topics similar to one's own habits are mentioned, gets activated
target_behavior.core_reason: High sense of threat about being judged and Self-doubt, along with beliefs like 'black-and-white / overgeneralization'
target_behavior.function: Reducing Anxiety and the risk of being labeled in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Relationship estrangement,Increased sense of isolation,Sleep and diet rhythm disturbance
